title: SURVEY AND FEASIBILITY STUDY OF RF TECHNOLOGIES FOR THE L4 ENCELADUS LANDER - EXPRO+
description: To perform a survey study and experimental of RF technologies to demonstrate the suitability of this technology for ranging, surface characterization in the frame of the L4- Enceladus mission.DescriptionRF technologies (such as FMCW systems) have proven their efficiency for ranging and hazard detection for terrestrial and space applications.Additionally, water ice / snow soils have strong distinctive RF signatures for example in themicrowave frequency range.1) Review of L4 needs and requirements vs existing RF technologies and devices.
